message:
40F. My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get. I'm out of sumatriptan and would like a refill.

Additional patient information: It came on gradually, like my usual migraines. No new weakness or trouble speaking.

output.patientMessage: I recommend clinician review in this message thread today for your sumatriptan refill request, since you're in an attack now and out of your rescue medicine. Your description matches your usual migraine pattern. If that review can't be obtained today, contact another same-day prescriber. Call 911 if you develop sudden new weakness or trouble speaking; seek urgent in-person care for an abrupt, worst-ever headache, fever with neck stiffness, or a headache clearly unlike your usual ones.

citations.quote: Typical features of an attack include a unilateral location, pulsating quality, moderate or severe pain intensity, and aggravation by routine physical activity4,13.
citations.claim: Unilateral pulsating headache with photophobia is a typical migraine presentation.
citations.limitation: Describes typical features; does not confirm this diagnosis remotely.

citations.quote: Triptans are most effective when taken early in an attack, when the headache is still mild49,50.
citations.claim: Triptans are most effective when taken early in an attack, supporting timely prescribing review.
citations.limitation: Source addresses treatment timing, not remote prescribing eligibility.
